yaw_gain_compensation.description: Fraction of predicted yaw the chassis delivers, divided out of the steering demand (compensation). 1.0 = OFF; base/Open value OFF.

obstacles_yaw_gain_compensation.description: Obstacles-only compensation for the plant's under-turn, divided out of the steering demand. Ships 0.55 (full); unvalidated on hardware.

open_lookahead_long.description: Lookahead for straights (m), Open Challenge only. Obstacles keeps the shared lookahead_long.

lookahead_transition.description: Crosstrack error threshold to switch modes (m) -- a ceiling; see below

lookahead_blend_start.description: Fraction of the crosstrack threshold where the long-to-short lookahead ramp begins; 1.0 = the old hard switch, lower gives a deadband.

steer_kp.description: Proportional gain for the steering P-controller

max_steering_rate.description: Maximum steering command rate (rad/s), a cornering policy. Distinct from the hardware model servo_slew_rate_rad_s.

target_search_span_m.description: How far along the path target selection may walk before giving up (m). 0 = whole lap (unbounded); 1.0 is about 3x the lookahead.

target_sense_gate.description: Reject a candidate reachable only by going round the loop the wrong way: project the pose-to-candidate bearing on the path's travel direction. Ships false.

servo_slew_rate_rad_s.description: Servo hardware slew rate (rad/s), a model distinct from the max_steering_rate policy. Loaded bench measurement; the bay reverse pause rides on it.

wall_margin_safety_m.description: Clearance to leave between chassis and outer wall (m); caps the crosstrack threshold at what the path's own distance to the wall affords.

corner_preview_distance_m.description: Path distance previewed for an upcoming turn (m); arms the short lookahead on corner entry. Larger spends more of the lap on the short lookahead.

corner_turn_threshold_rad.description: Heading change over the preview distance that counts as a corner (rad); gates the corner preview. Insensitive over 0.21 to 0.58.

min_target_radius_m.description: Minimum-radius floor on pursuit planning (m). 0.0 disables the floor; measured and ships off.
